cards.name: 「Void Reforge」Vision
cards.text: TRIG【VOID】:When this card enters VOID from RETREAT, you may discard 2 cards in HAND. If you do, you place this card from VOID into your field, and your opponent's character in FRONT gets Power-1000 in this turn.

cards.name: 「Quantum Tunneling」Ant-Man
cards.text: TRIG【RETREAT】：When this card enters RETREAT from the field, you prune this card in RETREAT. If you do, you move 1 of your characters with Lv3 and without 【Ant-Man】 in their names from VOID back to the top of your deck.

cards.name: 「Echo of Fate」Spider-Man
cards.text: UNIQUE TRIG【FIELD】:When you attach this card to a character on the field, you move 1 of your characters with 【Web】 in their features from RETREAT or VOID back to your HAND. ACTI【HAND】:If you have any Weaknesses, you prune 5 of your characters with 【Web】 in their features in RETREAT. If you do, you place this card from HAND onto your BATTLE and retreat 1 of your opponent's characters on the field.

cards.name: 「Astral Visitor」Doctor Strange
cards.text: ACTI【VOID/ONCE PER TURN】:You prune 1 of your characters with Lv4 or above in RETREAT. If you do, you place this card from VOID into your field.

cards.name: 「The Web of Destiny」Spider-Man
cards.text: UNIQUE TRIG【BASE/ONCE PER TURN】:When your card with 【Web】 in its feature enters the field, you may attach 1 of your characters with 【Web】 in their features from HAND to 1 of the characters on the field. TRIG【VOID】:When this card enters VOID by your effect, you may place this card from VOID into your BASE.

cards.name: 「Straight and Narrow」Uncle Ben
cards.text: UNIQUE BLOCK TRIG【RETREAT】:When this card enters RETREAT from BATTLE by losing the fight, you prune the top 3 cards of your deck. If you do, you place 1 of your characters with the lowest Lv and 【Web】 in their features from VOID onto your BATTLE.

cards.name: 「Alliance Leader」Spider-Man 2099
cards.text: UNIQUE AUTO【FIELD】:Each character on your opponent's field gets Power-X000. X is the number of that character's attached cards with 【Web】 in their features. TRIG【VOID】:When this card enters VOID by the effect of a card with 【Web】 in its feature, you may prune the top 3 cards of your deck. If you do, you draw 1 card.

cards.name: 「Mirror Fate」Prowler
cards.text: TRIG【BATTLE】:When your character with 【Human】 in its feature enters RETREAT from BATTLE by losing the fight, you may prune this card on BATTLE. If you do, you place 1 of your characters with Lv3 and 【Spider-Man】 in their names from VOID onto the field.

cards.name: 「Restoration of Multiverse」Doctor Strange
cards.text: UNIQUE ACTI【BATTLE/ONCE PER TURN】:You discard 1 of your cards in HAND. If you do, you place 1 of your characters with 【Multiverse】 in their features from VOID onto your BATTLE. If that character is with Lv4 or above, you discard 1 of your cards in HAND extra.

TRIG【FIELD】:When your character with 【Web】 in its feature enters VOID, you may prune this card on the field. If you do, you place that character onto your BATTLE. If that character is with Lv4 or above, you discard 1 of your cards in HAND extra.

cards.name: 「Reversal of Multiverse」Spider-Punk
cards.text: AUTO【FIELD】：The character this card is attached to can only attack your opponent's FRONT or the character on FRONT. COUNTER·ACTI【HAND】：You discard this card in HAND.
